purpose: State-scoped inspection of the official Indiana ENR public JSON family retained in this repository. This artifact sharpens the current blocker for official same-grain precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate rows.

scriptEvidence.observation: The ENR app builds data JSON paths as data/<fileName>_<version>.json after settings.json reports VersionType A.
Startup fetches statewideElectionsC_A/statewideTickerC_A and then office category files named OffCatC_<OFFICECATEGORYID>_A.json from the office list.
The visible download-results directive fetches statewideTurnout_A.json and exports voter statistics only, not candidate result rows.

appDataPathProbe.conclusion: The public app path identifies office-category, ticker/settings, turnout, map, and referendum JurR files. It does not identify a public President or U.S. Senate precinct/subcounty candidate-result export.

livePublicPathRecheck.method: Ordinary public HTTPS GET requests to documented official ENR archive data paths; no browser automation, credentialed access, or anti-bot bypass was used.

endpoints.finding: Settings metadata remains publicly reachable and identifies the archive data version family.
President office-category JSON remains publicly reachable; retained/local inspection shows county/locality candidate summaries, not precinct/subcounty candidate rows.
U.S. Senate office-category JSON remains publicly reachable; retained/local inspection shows county/locality candidate summaries, not precinct/subcounty candidate rows.
The public download/statistics data path remains reachable for turnout-style data, not candidate result rows.

livePublicPathRecheck.conclusion: The ordinary public archive paths are reachable, but the checked ENR data family still exposes county-level President and U.S. Senate candidate rows plus turnout/statistics data, not a same-grain precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate export.

jurisdictionReportInventory.conclusion: The collected JurR files contain county jurisdiction/contact and reporting-region/referendum structures. They contain zero candidate containers on both the retained manifest and this rescan.

conclusion.blocker: The retained official ENR public JSON family supports county certified President and U.S. Senate rows, plus county turnout/statistics and referendum inventory. It does not expose same-grain precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate candidate rows needed to replace the supplemental MIT/OpenElections local review artifact.
conclusion.nextOfficialSourceStep: Request a statewide precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate export from the Indiana Election Division, then fall back to county election offices only if the state confirms no statewide export exists.
